# scdnalong: Contributing

scdnalong is **archived** and no longer takes contributions. It is kept so that results made
with release `0.0.1` can be reproduced.

New development, bug reports and feature requests belong in
[LRSinglecell](https://github.com/IntGenomicsLab/lrsinglecell), which processes single-cell
long-read DNA and cDNA in one pipeline. Please open an issue there:
<https://github.com/IntGenomicsLab/lrsinglecell/issues>.
